title: Variables
summary: Variables store values in memory so you can reuse them later. They act as containers that hold data such as numbers, text, or boolean values. A variable has a name and a value.
sample_question: What is a variable and why is it useful in programming?

title: Loops
summary: Loops allow you to repeat a block of code multiple times. A 'for' loop is used when the number of iterations is known, while a 'while' loop runs until a condition becomes false.
sample_question: Explain the difference between a for loop and a while loop with an example.
